blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Oil giant Shell Pilipinas will stagger the big-time fuel price hikes set this week, which will hit as high as P8.80 per liter. In an advisory, the company said diesel prices would surge by P7.80 per liter on Tuesday. READ: Oman says Strait of Hormuz talks with Iran, Gulf states postponed Gas and kerosene products will also be more expensive by P4.80 and P6.40 per liter, respectively. On Wednesday, motorists buying diesel from Shell would see an additional P1 per liter. Other fuel retailers have yet to announce their official price movement.
